limitations: ACS five-year estimates describe 2020–2024; estimates are not 2026 household counts. Margins of error reflect sampling uncertainty; modeled coverage has additional location uncertainty.
Household conditions overlap. One household measure is used at a time; percent persons below poverty is not a count of eligible households.
Coverage represents block-group internal points within modeled motor-vehicle road distance. It is not attendance, eligibility, transit access or driving directions.
Benefits sites have scheduled hours and finite capacity; geographic reach does not establish service availability.

All 24 library systems have pinned current-directory evidence. Only matching public branch locations are suggested; unresolved, administrative and obsolete inventory points are excluded. Baseline verification is incomplete: missing verified sites is not evidence that services are absent.
LODES main file covers home/work relationships with both ends in Maryland in 2021. It omits cross-border auxiliary-file relationships; flow lines are not observed routes.
QCEW employment measures private covered workplace jobs; annual pay is average nominal USD, not median household income.
